title: 留一张给朋友
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the smartphone interface. The text “已经收到了” is a message sent BY the phone owner: place that bubble aligned to the RIGHT side of the phone screen with its small tail pointing right. Above it, show a small outgoing attached thumbnail that faithfully repeats the TABLE-CORNER-HANDS photograph lying on the LEFT side of the table (no faces, only hands, cup and chair). Keep it also right-aligned. No timestamps, contact names, avatars, other messages or new photo subjects. Preserve both physical photographs on the tabletop, the old-street photograph on the right, all hands and phone perspective and lighting.
